parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The operation that you want to perform.   
Set the value to **ModifyTenantUserStatus**.

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.description: The list of database accounts in the tenant.

parameters.name: UserStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the database account. Valid values:   
- Locked: The account is locked. 
- Online: The account is unlocked.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro modify-tenant-user-status --user-name pay_test --tenant-id ob2mr3oae00000 --user-status LOCKED --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro ModifyTenantUserStatus --region cn-hangzhou --TenantId ob2mr3oae00000 --UserName pay_test --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --UserStatus LOCKED
